title: Lesson 6: Instruction-Level Parallelism & Out-of-Order Execution (Tomasulo) — js-tools
desc: ILP, superscalar CPUs, false WAR/WAW dependencies and register renaming, and the Tomasulo algorithm (reservation stations + CDB + ROB). Verified with a real engine: the WAR/WAW program runs in 9 cycles at IPC 0.333 with a final R1 of 18 thanks to in-order commit, while a real RAW chain is slower at 11 cycles and IPC 0.273.
